params.name: payment_type
params.description: The type of SSI to be returned, priority (Swift) or regular (local). A null value returns all payment types.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency of the account details required, ISO 4217 standard.

params.name: account_id
params.description: UUID of a specific sub-account you want to see the SSIs for.

params.name: on_behalf_of
params.description: A contact UUID for the sub-account you're acting on behalf of.

params.name: order
params.description: Any field name to change the sort order.

params.name: order_asc_desc
params.description: Sort records in ascending or descending order.
